claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch based on aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, provided the unresolved emergency-shelter-placement limitation is explicitly disclosed and post-deployment monitoring is described as supplemental mitigation.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold for certification.
A named launch-use-case limitation must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Draft monitoring materials can support risk management but do not remove the disclosure requirement or substitute for approved mitigation.
General public guidance can support disclosure/monitoring rationale but cannot replace missing internal approval predicates.
evidence_requests: A finalized model card or equivalent launch document explicitly disclosing the emergency shelter placement limitation for the named use case.
An approved mitigation or risk-acceptance record showing owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
The certification standard or decision memo confirming whether certification with an explicit disclosed limitation is permitted under this policy regime.
Evidence that the disclosed limitation and launch decision were reviewed and approved by the required governance authority.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a current unresolved weakness in a named launch use case: emergency shelter placement remains below target and is concentrated in family placement prioritization.
The cited mitigation is only a draft runbook, and its accountable owner and alert threshold are still marked TBD.

The policy text says certification without material caveats requires either current evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion; that predicate is not satisfied on this record.
The model-card draft currently says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the unresolved slice evidence and indicates the required disclosure has not yet been completed.
Public guidance on model cards and risk management supports disclosure and monitoring in general, but does not itself authorize certification under the internal policy threshold.
unsupported_claims: That certification is affirmatively supportable on the current record, rather than only potentially supportable after the limitation is actually disclosed and the governance path is clarified.
That the draft monitoring and rollback approach materially cures the policy problem; the evidence shows it is incomplete and unapproved.
Any implication that the current documentation state is already aligned with policy, since the model-card draft still says there are no known material limitations.
